VBO:0200116.summary: Often playful and attached to their household, Banter Bulldogges can settle indoors while remaining keen on active work and sounding an alarm at intruders. Todd Tripp developed this modern American breed in the late 1990s, inspired by the extinct Brabanter Bullenbeisser. His PullDoggies kennel competes in weight pull, keeping physical working tests central to its breeding.
VBO:0200116.shortDescription: Playful and attached to their household, Banter Bulldogges often enjoy active work and sound an alarm at intruders.

sources.title: Banter Bulldogge — Official IOEBA Breed Standard
sources.evidence: Personally read entire History, General Description, anatomy, Tail and Temperament. Exact modern late1990s Tripp program with extinct Brabanter inspiration; lower indoor energy, family attachment, rough play and alarm at trespassers are calibrated tendencies. Working proof encouraged. Avoids universal obedience, child suitability and protective guarantees.

sources.title: Banter Bulldogge — American Molosser Association Breed Standard
sources.evidence: Personally read actual complete two-page extracted standard. Page1 Background documents Todd Tripp/SoutheastOhio/late1990s modern project. Disposition covers family loyalty, eagerness and ability to relax, energy outlet and watchdog alarm. Pages1–2 morphology includes natural short drop/rose ears, high-set natural near-hock tail and athletic balanced leg length.

sources.title: PullDoggies — Todd Tripp’s Banter Bulldogge kennel
sources.evidence: Personally read complete founder body: Original Home in operation since1999, competing in weight pull, working dogs, breeding to original self-written standard recognizedBBF and registeredOBBA/IOEBA. This supports contemporary kennel activity, not every individual dog sport performance.

sources.title: Weight Pull 101 — Todd Tripp, PullDoggies
sources.evidence: Entire actual first-person article read. PullDoggies training facilities in Zephyrhills Florida support contemporary outdoor setting; repeated founder emphasis on dog development and gradual work is context only. No training or exercise prescriptions are transferred into profile or artwork.
